traces.question: What is the pit lane speed limit under the 2025 Formula 1 Sporting Regulations?
traces.answer: Under the 2025 Formula 1 Sporting Regulations, a speed limit of 80 km/h is imposed in the pit lane during the whole Competition, but this limit may be amended by the Race Director following a recommendation from the Safety Delegate (Article 34.7). Penalties apply if a driver exceeds this limit during free practice, qualifying, sprint qualifying, sprint sessions, or the race.
